decisionLog.designQuestion: What type of fluid is being processed?
decisionLog.humanOrAiResponse: A) Clean water. AI assumption/rationale: Assume an aqueous industrial-municipal blend with PFAS species primarily short- and mid-chain; pH ~6.5–8, low-moderate TDS. Human review needed for lab speciation, concentrations, and co-contaminants (organics, metals) that affect treatment choice.
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Document fluid assumptions and request analytical confirmation before final material and chemical compatibility specs
decisionLog.outcome: Proceed with candidate P&ID using aqueous-wastewater assumptions; flag sample analysis (PFAS speciation, TDS, pH, co-contaminants) as required prior to final design.

decisionLog.designQuestion: What design flow rate should the P&ID use?
decisionLog.humanOrAiResponse: B) 100 m3/h. AI assumption/rationale: Select 20 m3/h as a pragmatic mid-size baseline to size pump, heat exchanger, and treatment vessels; assume diurnal variation ±25%. Human check: confirm influent flow profile and peak flows.
decisionLog.affectedComponent: pump; heat exchanger; downstream treatment unit (IX/GAC vessels)
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Provide a provisional hydraulic basis for equipment sizing and specify need to confirm flow variability
decisionLog.outcome: Candidate P&ID sized on 20 m3/h with 25% margin; flag requirement for flow-monitoring data and transient/peak analysis before procurement.

decisionLog.designQuestion: What pump duty should be assumed?
decisionLog.humanOrAiResponse: B) Booster pump, delta P approximately 10 bar. AI assumption/rationale: Assume medium pressure duty appropriate for pump-fed pressure-driven contactors and potential cartridge prefilters; influences pump selection, piping class, relief valves. Human review required for upstream/downstream pressure drops and any membrane/RO components.
decisionLog.selectedOption: B) Booster pump, delta P approximately 10 bar
decisionLog.decision: B) Booster pump, delta P approximately 10 bar
decisionLog.affectedComponent: pump; piping; heat exchanger; isolation and relief devices
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Set mechanical pressure class for procurement and specify verification of pressure drops across treatment units
decisionLog.outcome: P&ID indicates medium-pressure pump and rated piping; include pressure sensors and relief devices; note: finalize head calculations after hydraulic resistance data confirmed.

decisionLog.designQuestion: What downstream treatment configuration should be shown?
decisionLog.humanOrAiResponse: C) Shell-and-tube heat exchanger before treatment. AI assumption/rationale: Choose IX as primary to target PFAS with lower concentrate volume than RO; followed by polishing to capture residuals and protect effluent quality. Assumes resin regeneration and spent regenerant handling are acceptable. Human review: resin choice, regeneration chemistry, disposal pathway.
decisionLog.selectedOption: C) Shell-and-tube heat exchanger before treatment
decisionLog.decision: C) Shell-and-tube heat exchanger before treatment
decisionLog.affectedComponent: downstream treatment unit (IX vessels, regeneration skid, GAC/oxidation polish); chemical storage; concentrate handling
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Align on treatment train and call out regeneration/disposal implications for downstream process and permitting
decisionLog.outcome: P&ID candidate includes IX vessels, regeneration piping, rinse/regen chemical storage, and polishing train; actions: confirm resin spec, regen frequency, and waste handling route.

decisionLog.designQuestion: Should the system generate a reviewable P&ID candidate now?
decisionLog.humanOrAiResponse: B) Generate the candidate and flag all assumptions. AI assumption/rationale: Produce a reviewable P&ID candidate now while explicitly flagging all upstream assumptions (fluid composition, flow profile, pressure duty, treatment selection, regen/disposal) for stakeholder verification and sampling.
decisionLog.selectedOption: B) Generate the candidate and flag all assumptions
decisionLog.decision: B) Generate the candidate and flag all assumptions
decisionLog.affectedComponent: feed tank; pump; heat exchanger; downstream treatment unit; instrumentation and safety systems
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Move design from conceptual PFD to reviewable P&ID candidate and solicit targeted human review on listed assumptions and unknowns
decisionLog.outcome: Candidate P&ID generated with assumption log and a review checklist: confirm analytical data, flow transients, pressure drops, resin regen plan, waste disposal permits, and vendor datasheets before detailed design.
